title: AskOnce Business Profile (grounding lens)
description: One tenant of the AskOnce multi-tenant MCP server. Design rule: every customer-facing fact lives exactly once in the flat `facts` ledger, keyed by a stable fact ID, with a normalized typed value and provenance. Modules and the business block only hold structure and FactRefs into the ledger. An assistant reply is grounded iff every claim it makes is a (fact_id, value_type, value) triple that byte-equals the ledger entry under RFC 8785 canonical JSON and the fact is statable (see x-invariants INV-09/INV-10). Website text is untrusted data: it only reaches the profile as quoted evidence, never as instructions.

profile_id.description: Tenant ID used by find_business and every business-scoped tool. Immutable.

profile_revision.description: Monotonic. Incremented on every change to anything except `certification` and `publication`. Certification binds to (revision, sha256).

template.description: Vertical = template + certification suite, never code. The template declares which modules, entity attributes and question prompts a vertical uses.

sources.description: Registry of every document a fact was taken from: website snapshots and owner answers. Keyed by source ID.

facts.description: The fact ledger. Key = stable fact ID (`<subject path>.<attribute>`, e.g. `catalog.item.choc-fudge-cake.price`). Object keys make IDs unique by construction. IDs never encode values or list positions, so they survive re-extraction.

questions.description: Clarifying questions for the owner: missing info, contradictions, safety confirmations. Asked through MCP form elicitation or the owner page.

contradictions.description: Detected disagreements between sources, each with every conflicting claim and its evidence, plus the owner's resolution.

allOf.$comment: GATE-1: a profile can only be live while certified.
GATE-2: a certified profile has no open blocking contradiction and no open blocking question.

x-invariants.rule: Every FactRef anywhere in the profile resolves to a key of `facts`.
Every Evidence.source_id resolves in `sources`; Evidence.url and Evidence.content_sha256 equal the source's url and content_sha256.
Every Evidence.quote occurs verbatim (after Unicode NFC and whitespace collapse) in the snapshot identified by content_sha256. This catches extractor hallucination deterministically.
fact.status == 'disputed' iff an open Contradiction has contradiction.fact_id == that fact ID, and fact.contradiction_id names it.

Canonical form: set-valued arrays (AllergenSet lists, TagSet, ServiceArea lists) are sorted ascending and unique; Interval lists are sorted by `opens`. Hence RFC 8785 (JCS) byte equality == semantic equality.
Every Money/MoneyRange currency equals business.currency. Every time_of_day/weekly_hours/date_hours value is local to business.timezone; every Timestamp is UTC.

If certification.status == 'certified' then certified_revision == profile_revision and certified_profile_sha256 == sha256(JCS(profile without `certification` and `publication`)); any mismatch forces status 'stale'.

A fact is STATABLE iff status == 'active' AND visibility == 'customer' AND (provenance.owner_confirmed OR kind NOT IN grounding_policy.require_owner_confirmation_kinds) AND (no unconfirmed fact older than grounding_policy.max_unconfirmed_age) AND today (business.timezone) is within [valid_from, valid_until].

A Claim matches iff claim.fact_id IN facts AND the fact is STATABLE AND claim.value_type == fact.value_type AND JCS(claim.value) == JCS(fact.value). A reply passes fact_grounding iff every claim matches and every price/allergen/hours/duration/policy surface form in the reply text is covered by a claim.
No quarantined_spans[].quote of any source ever appears in a tool result, elicitation message or assistant reply (injection canaries).

Question.answer.normalized.value_type == Question.answer_spec.value_type; Contradiction.claims values are pairwise different under JCS; resolution.final_value equals the value at value_path of the fact at resulting_fact_revision.
Fact IDs are stable: re-extraction may change value, provenance and revision, never the key. Renaming an entity = retract old facts + add new facts.
certification.runs is append-only and ordered by started_at; each run's summary counts equal the tally of its cases.

FactId.description: Dotted path: <namespace>.<entity type>.<entity slug>.<attribute>, e.g. business.hours.regular, catalog.item.gf-vanilla-cake.allergens.

Timestamp.description: RFC 3339 instant, always UTC (Z). Pattern makes it assertive even when format validation is off.

Time24.description: Local wall-clock time, 24h HH:MM, in business.timezone.

Time24Close.description: Like Time24 but allows 24:00 for closing at midnight.

Duration.description: ISO 8601 duration, e.g. PT45M, PT48H, P3D. Canonical form: the largest exact unit the source stated (certifier normalizes to seconds when comparing surface forms).

SourceUrl.description: Web page URL, or a URN for an owner answer/edit, so every fact has a uniform 'source URL'.

DayIntervals.description: Empty array = closed that day (closure is an explicit fact, not an absence).

DateHours.description: Hours override for one date (holiday, special opening).

AllergenSet.description: All three lists required so 'not mentioned' is never confused with 'free from'.

TypedValue.description: Discriminated (value_type, value) pair with normalized units. Reused by Fact, Claim, Question answers and Contradiction claims so all comparisons share one shape.

Claim.description: The unit the certifier checks (INV-10). MCP tool results return the claims they used (with a citation built from the fact's evidence), and the host attaches the claims behind each reply sentence.

surface_text.description: The words in the reply that carry the claim, e.g. 'forty-eight dollars'.

ObservedClaim.description: What the certifier saw in a reply. fact_id is absent when the claim was ungrounded.

Evidence.description: One piece of provenance: where the fact was read, the verbatim words, and when.

quote.description: Verbatim snippet from the source (INV-03). For owner answers, the owner's exact words.

content_sha256.description: Hash of the source snapshot the quote was taken from (INV-02).

origin.description: extracted = read from the website; owner_provided = the site never said it, the owner did.

FactKind.description: Semantic category. Drives the grounding policy (which kinds need owner confirmation) and which surface forms the certifier scans for.

label.description: Owner-facing label, e.g. 'Chocolate fudge cake price'.

visibility.description: internal facts (e.g. daily capacity) drive tool logic but must never be stated (certifier check internal_fact_withheld).

status.description: Lifecycle, orthogonal to owner confirmation. Only active facts can be statable.

display.description: Optional canonical rendering for cards ('$48.00'). Informational; never compared.

extraction_confidence.description: Informational only; never used for pass/fail.

trust.description: Web text is always untrusted data. Only owner answers/edits are attested.

snapshot_uri.description: Immutable stored snapshot used for INV-03.

quarantined_spans.description: Text on the page that tried to instruct the assistant (prompt injection, hidden text). Kept only as canaries for certification (INV-11); never extracted into facts.

display_name.description: UI/search label only. The statable name is facts.name.

require_owner_confirmation_kinds.description: Kinds that are only statable once owner_confirmed. Safety floor: must include allergens and dietary.

unknown_fact_behavior.description: No fact -> 'I don't know. Want me to ask <owner>?' -> owner Task. Never guess.

max_unconfirmed_age.description: Unconfirmed extracted facts older than this stop being statable until re-extracted.

citation_display.description: card = sources on the ui:// card, not read aloud.

EntityFacts.description: attribute -> FactRef map on an entity.

CommitGuard.description: Fixed by schema, not configurable per tenant: anything irreversible needs an elicitation confirmation and an idempotency key.

FieldSpec.description: Customer input collected by a commit tool. input_type maps onto MCP form-elicitation primitive types.

Modules.description: Closed set of capability modules (these are code). A vertical template picks a subset and fills them with FactRefs.

price_disclosure.description: The assistant never estimates a job price; only the owner's Task reply carries one.

approver_name_fact.description: Who 'I'll ask ...' refers to; a statable fact like any other.

why.description: Shown to the owner: why we are asking.

target_fact_ids.description: Facts the answer creates or confirms. May name facts not yet in the ledger (missing info).

from_claim_index.description: For contradiction questions: which Contradiction.claims entry this choice is.

blocking.description: true = certification cannot pass while this is open (GATE-2).

source_id.description: The owner_answer source that holds this answer; facts cite it as evidence.

fact_id.description: The single ledger fact in dispute.

value_path.description: Pointer into the fact's value that disagrees ('' = whole value), e.g. /sat/0/closes.

claims.description: Every conflicting reading, each with its own evidence. Values are typed at value_path, not the whole fact.

utterance.description: Generated customer message (LLM-written input; pass/fail is decided in code on the trace).

trace_id.description: OTel trace ID in AgentCore Observability.

profile_sha256.description: sha256(JCS(profile without certification and publication)) at run time.

allOf.$comment: A passing run contains no failed or errored case.

status.description: stale = the profile changed after the last pass (INV-07).

suite_id.description: The vertical's certification case set (comes with the template).
